entries.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal

entries.title: Bid to overturn ruling which stops British police being sued for failings

entries.title: AI is creating a 'human premium' for art made by people. But will it hold?

entries.title: Public executions in the US stopped nearly a century ago, so why are they resuming now?
